statement: The standard pure involution has centralizer and normalizer exactly its own C2 in the full pure pants group P. The actual orbit map β↦βδβ⁻¹ has exactly the two-element fibers {β,βδ}; its GT_0 orbit is the intersection of its P orbit with GT_0. On that specified orbit the two conjugators have multipliers μ and −μ and the same unique normalized h. D.35's third-cusp conjugators are u(xy)^a and x^(−μ)u(xy)^a.
manuscript_passages: Part D of the task: full GT_0 involution conjugacy
notes: The GT self-centralizer result is attributed to Lochak–Schneps, whose original PDF was reopened and Proposition 4(ii)/Lemma 9 read. The proof explicitly supplies the inclusion from P through the commutator r_sigma and the exact normalized pairs. Heisenberg quotients give μ²=1 and D.34 couples its prime signs. The orbit statement makes no claim that every pure or GT_0 involution belongs to this orbit.
